experiences.title: Software Engineer Intern
experiences.description: Worked on the Software team supporting the MK41 Vertical Launch Systems (VLS) and collaborated with a team to design tracking algorithms for a search radar system.

experiences.title: Data Analyst
experiences.description: Standardized data across 18 Johnson & Johnson sites using a centralized database to improve GMP compliance and Product Quality Review analytics. Created interactive dashboards in Excel and Looker Studio, streamlining global manufacturing processes. This was a part of a term project.

experiences.title: Student Researcher
experiences.description: Worked on processing video data from heat pipe experiments that were run on the ISS. Researched machine learning methods to more clearly render flow boiling images, testing the use of the skimage library and a Mask R-CNN on datasets.

projects.title: FlyBy
projects.description: Second place winner of the 2025 NSBE x SHPE Climate Change & Sustainability Hackathon @ Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute. FlyBy is a web application that leverages deep-learning computer vision to detect and analyze marine trash in aerial footage. It leverages a YOLOv5 vision model trained on the TACO dataset.

projects.title: Asian Cafe Website
projects.description: I built this website for my parents' restaurant, Asian Cafe, to improve their online ordering system and enhance customer convenience. I'm also developing a custom POS system to streamline their small business operations, which is still in progress.

projects.title: tomeeto
projects.description: tomeeto is a scheduling website that solves the logistics problem of figuring out when everyone is available to meet. Our goal was to simplify the process of communication with a simple and intuitive interface.

projects.title: AIpaca
projects.description: AI-paca, submitted for SASE Hacks 2024, is a mobile app that lets users photograph animal sightings, which are then analyzed by a deep learning classifier to identify species. The goal was to help adolescents participate in conservation efforts using their phones and help researches have more access to data.

projects.title: Cool Academic RPI Bot (CARPI)
projects.description: CARPI started off as a discord bot that provided RPI students with easy access to university resources from an application that they use daily. With the progress on the bot completed, we have shifted to also create an online web resource, starting with a custom 4-year planner.

projects.title: Lucid
projects.description: Lucid was an image super-resolution model I implemented using the ESRGAN architecture. The goal was to upscale drawing and images for easier use. Integrated TensorFlow and OpenCV to optimize performance and enhance output quality.
